subject: Post-discovery technical deep-dive: deployment topology & access controls
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Eli Tan <eli.t@orchestrate.ai>; Priya Desai <priya.desai@orchestrate.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery technical deep-dive: deployment topology & access controls

Hi Eli / Priya —

Great to meet during discovery last week. Thanks for walking us through your latency targets and the multi-region constraints — that helped a lot. As discussed, we recommend a focused technical deep-dive next to validate the deployment topology, SSO/KMS integration points, and network considerations (VPC peering vs. private link).

Proposed agenda (30–45 min):
- 5 min: brief recap of current architecture
- 15 min: deployment options we recommend (hosted / dedicated / private) with tradeoffs
- 10 min: SSO (SAML/OIDC) and key management patterns
- 10 min: network & egress controls, data residency notes and next steps

Suggested time windows (Pacific / Eastern):
- Wed Aug 4: 10:00–10:45 PT / 13:00–13:45 ET
- Wed Aug 4: 15:00–15:45 PT / 18:00–18:45 ET
- Thu Aug 5: 08:00–08:45 PT / 11:00–11:45 ET

Attendees from our side: me (AE, product fit + roadmap), Ben Carter (Solutions Lead), Mina Haddad (Solutions Eng — will run the architecture portion).

Prep: attaching a short agenda and a one-page network checklist. If you can share the attendee list and any specific constraints (e.g., firewall restrictions, mandatory proxies, or compliance reviewers), we’ll tailor the deep-dive.

Looking forward — please reply with a preferred slot or alternate times.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Eli Tan <eli.t@orchestrate.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@orchestrate.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 11:04:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery technical deep-dive: deployment topology & access controls

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks — the agenda looks great and aligns with our needs. Quick note on availability: Wednesday Aug 4 at 10:00 PT works for Priya and me, but our principal architect (Jared) is only free after 15:00 PT. Can you confirm who absolutely needs to attend from your side? If Jared should be present, we may need the later slot.

Also, we have a corporate rule that any session touching KMS or key exchange needs at least one security reviewer on call. I can loop them in if we pick the later slot.

Two quick answers to the prep:
- We do use an outbound proxy for a subset of services (will share IPs if required).
- Data residency: our EU customers must keep inference results in-region, but the pilot is US-only.

Best,
Eli
Eli Tan
VP of Platforms
Orchestrate AI

Vanessa / Mina —

If prospect can do 15:00 PT we should have Jared and their security reviewer present; that slot gives us time to prep a short demo of SSO + KMS flow. I can run the deployment-options segment but recommend Mina lead the technical diagrams.

I’ll draft a calendar invite with both time options and mark the 15:00 PT as tentative.
